title: International Postgraduate Admission, Fall 2027
institution: Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST)
about: E-JUST's international postgraduate admission for Fall 2027 accepts applications from November 8, 2026 to January 10, 2027. Screening follows in February, online interviews and exams February 21-25, results March 31, and classes start September 19, 2027.
requirements: Apply online through the E-JUST website
Certificates must be certified by the Egyptian embassy in the country of the awarding institution
card_alt: Card for International Postgraduate Admission, Fall 2027 at Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST), Egypt, deadline 10 Jan 2027. The photo shows the minarets of the Sultan Hassan and Al-Rifai mosques in Cairo, with the Giza pyramids on the horizon at sunset.
